parameters.initial_state: Establish and verify root and child state through the normal pipeline before the measured child-only batch.

readback: Group children independently by root_id and compare root fields and complete child members in ascending child-key order.
Verify updated and removed members and unchanged roots; one merged target acknowledgement cannot count as multiple independent samples.

completion.target_unit: root document or acknowledged write group
completion.evidence: Actual acknowledgement for every expected target unit. A separate readback checks expected keys and values.
